messages:
mara: Quick proposal: soft server-side redirect for /v1/generate -> /v2/generate next Tue, with console preview and per-route opt-in. want opinions on billing + telemetry.
jonathan: Sounds good. billing question: if we route to v2, do tokens show as v2 in invoices? customers will freak if numbers change.
ash: Today we attribute to destination route (so billed as v2). that hides origin.
sam: That makes migrations opaque. We should surface where calls started.
anna-ux: UX need: a "Route Upgrade Preview" modal that shows 7d baseline, estimated token delta, $ delta, and a small list of tenants likely impacted. non-technical PMs should grok dollars.
mara: Implementation idea: add an attribution tag on usage events: origin_version=v1 and routed_version=v2. keep header across proxies: X-Redwood-Origin-Version. preserves upstream intent in telemetry.
jonathan: Good. Billing pipeline can then split usage by origin_version for invoices and by routed_version for runtime cost.
ash: Practical: middleware injects header when we detect an automatic routing decision. patch router to set header, then pipe through usage pings.
sam: Security: these headers land in internal logs/audit. set short retention and add tenant-level opt-out. also mark PII=false in schema.
mara: Rollout plan: dry-run (no billing change) -> 1% canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. automatic rollback triggers: p95 latency +25% OR token_per_request +30% OR error_rate +0.5% abs.
anna-ux: Console features: heatmap of routes showing compatibility score (0-100) + per-tenant impact list + a preview modal with figma link. also a banner copy: "We're upgrading this endpoint for better perf and cost. Preview impact in Console -> Routes."
jonathan: Edge rule: respect explicit client preference. routing precedence: 1) prefer_version header 2) console pin 3) auto-route. older SDKs that pin v1 mustnt be auto-routed.
nash: Metrics: emit compat.silent_routed_count tagged by route and tenant, and compat.routed_token_delta for billing estimates.
sam: Also add a console chart correlating silent_routed_count vs billing_delta_estimate for finance.
mara: Deploy bot: after each canary step we want a concise post: canary_start, sample_size, delta_summary, top-tenant-deltas, rollback flag.
deploy-bot: (system) queued canary job: canary-run 1767777788, will post results to this thread.
anna-ux: Quick microcopy for modal CTA: "Preview upgrade" -> shows projected $ impact and a compatibility checklist.
jonathan: Action owners: infra emit headers & metrics (jonathan), billing ingest origin_version (sam), ux mock & heatmap (anna-ux), router precedence tests (ash). aim for dry-run preview by EOD Fri.
mara: If no objections to the attribution approach, i'll file the router PR and console spec.
ash: no objections.
sam: SGTM.
deploy-bot: (system) scheduled canary-run 1767777788 at 1767777908
